changes: Capture Now is redesigned: about a third smaller, with clearer mode tiles, sliding Send to and Delay controls, animated switches and the capture shortcut shown as keycaps.
Choose a Capture Now theme in Settings: Midnight, Ember, Aurora or Porcelain.
The Capture view uses the same switches and segmented controls, with a prominent Capture Now button.
Checkboxes, the workspace background, toolbar shadow and status bar are refreshed across the app.
macos: The macOS top MyImage menu opens the same About dialog as the in-app menu, with What’s New and Check for Updates actions.
Check GitHub for a newer Mac version and build, then open the matching Mac download.
windows: Store-installed copies check Microsoft Store for updates available to this installation. Open the Store to update.
